papers.title: MindSearch: Mimicking Human Minds Elicits Deep AI Searcher
papers.authors: Zehui Chen, Kuikun Liu, Qiuchen Wang, Jiangning Liu, Wenwei Zhang, Kai Chen, Feng Zhao
papers.affiliations: MoE Key Laboratory of Brain-inspired Intelligent Perception and Cognition, USTC; Shanghai AI Laboratory
papers.intro: MindSearch提出了一个受人类认知过程启发的多智能体框架，通过WebPlanner动态构建有向无环图分解问题，并并行调度多个WebSearcher进行层次化检索，从而在3分钟内从超过300个网页中高效整合信息，质量超越ChatGPT-Web和Perplexity.ai。

papers.title: LongVideoBench: A Benchmark for Long-context Interleaved Video-Language Understanding
papers.authors: Haoning Wu, Dongxu Li, Bei Chen, Junnan Li
papers.tags: multimodal learning, visual question answering, video search
papers.intro: 该论文提出了LongVideoBench——一个面向长达一小时、视频与字幕交错输入的多选题问答基准，通过新颖的"Referring Reasoning"任务设计，有效克服了已有视频基准的单帧偏置问题，系统评估了主流闭源和开源多模态大模型在长上下文视频理解上的真实能力。

papers.title: Agent-E: From Autonomous Web Navigation to Foundational Design Principles in Agentic Systems
papers.authors: Tamer Abuelsaad, Deepak Akkil, Prasenjit Dey, Ashish Jagmohan, Aditya Vempaty, Ravi Kokku
papers.intro: 论文提出Agent-E——一种采用分层架构、灵活DOM蒸馏和变化观察机制的Web Agent，在WebVoyager基准上以73.2%成功率超越现有文本/多模态SOTA 10%-30%，并提炼出通用Agent系统设计原则。

papers.title: Spider2-V: How Far Are Multimodal Agents From Automating Data Science and Engineering Workflows?
papers.authors: Ruisheng Cao, Fangyu Lei, Haoyuan Wu, Jixuan Chen, Yeqiao Fu, Hongcheng Gao, Xinzhuang Xiong, Hanchong Zhang, Yuchen Mao, Wenjing Hu, Tianbao Xie, Hongshen Xu, Danyang Zhang, Sida Wang, Ruoxi Sun, Pengcheng Yin, Caiming Xiong, Ansong Ni, Qian Liu, Victor Zhong, Lu Chen, Kai Yu, Tao Yu
papers.affiliations: The University of Hong Kong (1), Shanghai Jiao Tong University (2), Google Cloud AI Research (3), Google DeepMind (4), Salesforce Research (5), Yale University (6), Sea AI Lab (7), University of Waterloo (8)
papers.intro: 本文提出Spider2-V，第一个覆盖完整数据科学和工程工作流的多模态智能体基准，包含494个真实任务、20个企业级应用，在可执行计算机环境中评估智能体的代码和GUI操作能力，并揭示现有最优VLM/LLM智能体远不能实现自动化（最高成功率14%）。

papers.title: Systematic Categorization, Construction and Evaluation of New Attacks against Multi-modal Mobile GUI Agents
papers.authors: Yulong Yang, Xinshan Yang, Shuaidong Li, Chenhao Lin, Zhengyu Zhao, Chao Shen, Tianwei Zhang
papers.affiliations: Xi'an Jiaotong University；Nanyang Technological University；Nankai University；Wuhan University
papers.intro: 本文首次系统性地对多模态移动GUI代理进行安全研究，提出新威胁建模方法发现34种未报道的攻击，并设计统一框架SecMoba用于攻击构建与评估，通过真实案例和大规模实验验证了攻击的严重性与实用性。

papers.title: AUITestAgent: Automatic Requirements Oriented GUI Function Testing
papers.authors: Yongxiang Hu, Xuan Wang, Yingchuan Wang, Yu Zhang, Shiyu Guo, Chaoyi Chen, Xin Wang, Yangfan Zhou
papers.intro: 本文提出了AUITestAgent，一种基于自然语言驱动的移动应用GUI功能测试自动化工具，通过解耦交互与验证、动态组织代理模式以及多维数据提取策略，实现了从测试需求到测试结果的全自动流程，在自定义基准测试中验证准确性达94%，并在美团实际部署中检测到多个新功能缺陷。

papers.title: Internet of Agents: Weaving a Web of Heterogeneous Agents for Collaborative Intelligence
papers.authors: Weize Chen, Ziming You, Ran Li, Yitong Guan, Chen Qian, Chenyang Zhao, Cheng Yang, Ruobing Xie, Zhiyuan Liu, Maosong Sun
papers.affiliations: Tsinghua University, Peking University, Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications, Tencent
papers.intro: 受互联网启发，提出“智能体互联网”（IoA）框架，通过智能体集成协议、即时消息式架构设计以及动态组队和会话流控制机制，实现异构智能体在分布式环境下的高效协作。

papers.title: MobileFlow: A Multimodal LLM For Mobile GUI Agent
papers.authors: Songqin Nong, Jiali Zhu, Rui Wu, Jiongchao Jin, Shuo Shan, Xiutian Huang, Wenhao Xu
papers.intro: MobileFlow是一个基于Qwen-VL-Chat改造的多模态大语言模型（约21B参数），通过混合视觉编码器、MoE扩展和对齐训练策略，在不调用系统API的前提下实现可变分辨率、多语言支持的移动GUI理解与操作任务，在公开和业务指标上超越GPT-4v和Qwen-VL-Max。

papers.title: MobileExperts: A Dynamic Tool-Enabled Agent Team in Mobile Devices
papers.authors: Jiayi Zhang, Chuang Zhao, Yihan Zhao, Zhaoyang Yu, Ming He, Jianping Fan
papers.affiliations: AI Lab at Lenovo Research（Ming He, Jianping Fan）；Renmin University of China（Jiayi Zhang, Yihan Zhao, Zhaoyang Yu）；The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology（Chuang Zhao）
papers.intro: MobileExperts提出一种动态工具启用的多智能体协作框架，通过代码组合工具制定和双层规划机制，首次在移动设备操作领域引入工具制定与多智能体团队协作，在提升智能水平的同时降低了约22%的推理成本。

papers.title: AMEX: Android Multi-annotation Expo Dataset for Mobile GUI Agents
papers.authors: Yuxiang Chai, Siyuan Huang, Yazhe Niu, Han Xiao, Liang Liu, Dingyu Zhang, Shuai Ren, Hongsheng Li
papers.affiliations: MMLab @ CUHK, SJTU, vivo AI Lab
papers.intro: 本文提出AMEX，一个包含超10万张高分辨率截图、涵盖交互元素定位、屏幕/元素功能描述及复杂自然语言指令-动作链的多层级Android GUI数据集，并基于SPHINX模型微调得到SphAgent，验证了该数据集对提升GUI代理性能的有效性。

papers.title: Seeing is Believing: Vision-driven Non-crash Functional Bug Detection for Mobile Apps
papers.authors: Zhe Liu, Cheng Li, Chunyang Chen, Junjie Wang, Mengzhuo Chen, Boyu Wu, Yawen Wang, Jun Hu, Qing Wang
papers.affiliations: State Key Laboratory of Intelligent Game, Institute of Software Chinese Academy of Sciences, University of Chinese Academy of Sciences (Zhe Liu, Cheng Li, Junjie Wang, Mengzhuo Chen, Boyu Wu, Yawen Wang, Jun Hu, Qing Wang); Technical University of Munich (Chunyang Chen)
papers.intro: 本文提出Trident，一种基于多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的视觉驱动、多智能体协同的自动化GUI测试方法，用于检测移动应用中的非崩溃功能bug，通过三个智能体（Explorer、Monitor、Detector）实现功能导向的探索与oracle推断，在590个非崩溃bug上取得显著优于12个基线方…

papers.title: CRAB: Cross-environment Agent Benchmark for Multimodal Language Model Agents
papers.authors: Tianqi Xu, Linyao Chen, Dai-Jie Wu, Yanjun Chen, Zecheng Zhang, Xiang Yao, Zhiqiang Xie, Yongchao Chen, Shilong Liu, Bochen Qian, Anjie Yang, Zhaoxuan Jin, Jianbo Deng, Philip Torr, Bernard Ghanem, Guohao Li
papers.affiliations: KAUST, Eigent.AI, CAMEL-AI.org, UTokyo, CMU, Stanford, Harvard, Tsinghua, SUSTech, Oxford, NU（详见第十二节）
papers.intro: 论文提出了CRAB，首个支持跨环境任务的智能体基准测试框架，通过基于图的任务分解与评估方法，高效构建多平台任务，并在120个真实跨设备任务上对6种主流MLM进行了系统评测。

papers.title: Read Anywhere Pointed: Layout-aware GUI Screen Reading with Tree-of-Lens Grounding
papers.authors: Yue Fan, Lei Ding, Ching-Chen Kuo, Shan Jiang, Yang Zhao, Xinze Guan, Jie Yang, Yi Zhang, Xin Eric Wang
papers.affiliations: University of California, Santa Cruz；eBay Inc.；Cybever
papers.intro: 本论文提出Tree-of-Lens (ToL) 智能体，通过构建层次化布局树并生成多级视觉提示，使多模态大模型能够对用户指示的任意屏幕点生成包含内容和布局信息的自然语言描述。

papers.title: Chrono: A Simple Blueprint for Representing Time in MLLMs
papers.authors: Hector Rodriguez, Boris Meinardus, Anil Batra, Anna Rohrbach, Marcus Rohrbach
papers.intro: 本文提出Chrono——一种简单、通用的多模态输入序列蓝图，通过将语言形式的时间戳与视频帧交错输入并附加视频总时长，无需任何架构改动即可让图像-文本预训练MLLM具备强大的视频时间定位能力，在多个基准上刷新SOTA。

papers.title: Octo-planner: On-device Language Model for Planner-Action Agents
papers.authors: Wei Chen, Zhiyuan Li, Zhen Guo, Yikang Shen
papers.affiliations: Nexa AI & Stanford (Wei Chen, Zhiyuan Li), MIT EECS (Zhen Guo), MIT-IBM Watson AI Lab (Yikang Shen)
papers.intro: 本文提出Octo-planner，一个基于Phi-3 Mini轻量化大模型、通过微调替代上下文学习的设备端规划代理，与Octopus动作模型组成Planner-Action框架，实现了在资源受限设备上97%的规划成功率。

papers.title: Changen2: Multi-Temporal Remote Sensing Generative Change Foundation Model
papers.authors: Zhuo Zheng, Stefano Ermon, Dongjun Kim, Liangpei Zhang, Yanfei Zhong
papers.tags: image generation, diffusion model, Segment Anything
papers.affiliations: Stanford University（Zhuo Zheng, Stefano Ermon, Dongjun Kim）；Wuhan University（Liangpei Zhang, Yanfei Zhong）
papers.intro: 本文提出Changen2，一个基于分辨率可扩展扩散变换器的生成式变化基础模型，能够从单时相遥感图像自动生成时间序列图像及其语义和变化标签，并利用自监督学习在大规模无标签数据上训练，所得预训练模型在多种真实变化检测任务上展现出接近全监督的零样本性能和优异的迁移性。

papers.title: Identifying User Goals from UI Trajectories
papers.authors: Omri Berkovitch, Sapir Caduri, Noam Kahlon, Anatoly Efros, Avi Caciularu, Ido Dagan
papers.affiliations: Google Research (所有作者), Ido Dagan 同时隶属于 Bar-Ilan University
papers.intro: 本文首次提出了从UI轨迹中识别用户目标（Goal Identification）的新任务，利用UI自动化数据集逆向构建实验数据，并设计了基于互满足关系的评估方法，实验表明现有最强多模态模型远不及人类表现。

papers.title: E-ANT: A Large-Scale Dataset for Efficient Automatic GUI NavigaTion
papers.authors: Ke Wang, Tianyu Xia, Zhangxuan Gu, Yi Zhao, Shuheng Shen, Changhua Meng, Weiqiang Wang, Ke Xu
papers.intro: 本文构建了E-ANT，一个包含超过49,000条真实用户操作轨迹、覆盖20,000+不同中文小程序的GUI导航数据集，并提供丰富的页面元素标注和多种MLLM的基准评测，旨在推动中文GUI导航及多模态大模型决策能力的研究。

papers.title: VGA: Vision GUI Assistant -- Minimizing Hallucinations through Image-Centric Fine-Tuning
papers.authors: Ziyang Meng, Yu Dai, Zezheng Gong, Shaoxiong Guo, Minglong Tang, Tongquan Wei
papers.tags: multimodal learning, visual question answering, gui
papers.intro: 本文提出VGA，一种通过图像中心微调（自建63.8k VQA数据集和两阶段微调方法FAC）来减少幻觉并提升LVLM对GUI理解准确性的方法，在多种GUI任务上达到当前最优。

papers.title: GUI Action Narrator: Where and When Did That Action Take Place?
papers.authors: Qinchen Wu, Difei Gao, Kevin Qinghong Lin, Zhuoyu Wu, Xiangwu Guo, Peiran Li, Weichen Zhang, Hengxu Wang, Mike Zheng Shou
papers.affiliations: Show Lab, National University of Singapore；Chinese Academy of Sciences, Shenzhen
papers.intro: 论文构建了首个大规模GUI动作视频描述基准Act2Cap（4189个样本），并提出了利用光标作为视觉提示的框架GUI Narrator，通过光标检测、关键帧与关键区域选择增强多模态大模型对高分辨率GUI截图的精细理解。
